name: Catastrophic Perils
summary: You drop to 0 hit points. Every creature within 30 ft takes 4d6 psychic damage. A hostile Warp entity, hallucination, corruption event, daemon sign, or possession threat enters the scene. After resolving Catastrophic Perils, the character gains 1 Corruption.
